disclaimer: Pre-registered lab hypotheses and holdout verdicts from pinned vendored registry files. Falsified results stay published. Nothing here is a live order, a trading signal, or advice.

hypotheses.title: Kalshi maker spread capture
hypotheses.hypothesis: Resting as a Kalshi maker on the recorded public tape, joining the reconstructed last-trade touch on both sides, size 100, behind a queue of 100 contracts, marking one-sided leftovers at the last print, and paying published Kalshi maker fees, has strictly positive mean after-fee expected value on the frozen primary holdout.
hypotheses.holdout: 15-minute windows ending in [2026-10-01, 2026-11-10) UTC; second holdout sealed
hypotheses.verdict: FALSIFIED. n=327 missed the frozen 400 gate. Mean after-fee EV −111 bps. Second holdout was not opened. Do not promote.

hypotheses.title: FX realized-vol walk-forward
hypotheses.hypothesis: HAR-RV has lower QLIKE than GARCH(1,1), EWMA λ=0.94, and naive last RV on a leakage-safe ECB daily realized-variance walk-forward, with a robust pair-level Model Confidence Set.
hypotheses.holdout: Pooled outer-fold n=40,824; origin 109 of each pair remained closed
hypotheses.verdict: FALSIFIED as a robust finding. Pair-count QLIKE MCS (α=0.10) includes EWMA only. HAR-RV’s pooled lead is a EURCHF composition effect. No robust winner. Not a trading signal.

hypotheses.title: Fade-the-favorite calibration
hypotheses.hypothesis: Kalshi last pre-close YES trade prices on settled binary markets overstate the favorite. Buying the underdog at that last pre-close price at size 100 with published quadratic taker fees has strictly positive mean after-fee expected value on the frozen holdout window.
hypotheses.holdout: Settled binaries with close_time in [2026-09-01, 2026-11-24) UTC
hypotheses.verdict: FALSIFIED. Miscalibration exists, but fade-the-favorite loses after fees. Do not promote.

hypotheses.title: Polymarket → BTC spot lead/lag
hypotheses.hypothesis: The first 1-minute |Δp| ≥ 0.05 in Polymarket BTC 15m Up/Down predicts a profitable 4-minute BTCUSDT spot trade after 10+10 bps taker fees.
hypotheses.holdout: Polymarket BTC 15m windows ending in [2026-10-01, 2026-11-24) UTC
hypotheses.verdict: FALSIFIED. Prediction-market lead/lag does not beat costs on this holdout. Do not promote.

hypotheses.title: 5-day FX reversal vs random walk
hypotheses.hypothesis: A 5-day reversal of trailing ECB close returns (with a turn-of-month overlay) has lower after-cost MAE than a zero random walk on frozen-holdout FX majors.
hypotheses.holdout: Pooled outer-fold n=40,824; origin 109 of each pair remained closed
hypotheses.verdict: FALSIFIED. After a 1 bp charge, every candidate is worse than random walk on every pair. Not a trading signal.

hypotheses.title: ECB USD-major next-day return walk-forward
hypotheses.hypothesis: A leakage-safe expanding-window RandomForest on ECB-derived USD majors forecasts next-day returns with usable directional skill.
hypotheses.verdict: FALSIFIED as a directional edge. Near-50% direction and negative R² mean this baseline has no usable daily skill. Paper/research only; not P&L.
